 🚨 We’re tracking Zelda Switch 2 stock updates. If you’d like to know when more stock arrives, follow Matt Swider on X and turn on notifications. You can also become a free or paid subscriber to The Shortcut to help support our work. 🚨 
 Target has shared that it will begin taking Zelda Switch 2 orders online starting November 6, as shared on the product listing page. It’s the only retailer that has announced such a date, and we’re inclined to believe it will have new stock on that date as the Zelda Switch 2 Pro Controller still says sold out, with no order date promised. 
 🚨 Want the Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2? Drop your email for restock alerts before it sells out. Paid subscribers can access our restock tracker tool directly ⤵️
 Subscribe While our exclusive restock tracker should be your first point of call, it’s important to know when Target is likely to hold its restock. After all, if you’re not by your phone, computer, or simply forget a restock is happening, the chances are you could miss out.
 Target has made it clear when the Zelda Switch 2 will be back in stock. (Credit: The Shortcut) Target has a history of holding restocks earlier in the day. We’ve seen the retailer restock hard-to-find items at 6am-10am local time, which is earlier than most of its competitors. A morning Zelda Switch 2 restock could be on the cards, then, though we’ll be tracking Target’s stock and will alert our followers as soon as we see stock is live.
